defects.symptom: Context retention could delete a final provider-request snapshot after it was pinned or while pin creation raced deletion.

defects.root_cause: Snapshot persistence and retention deletion did not share a storage-identity lock or typed pin authority.

defects.symptom: Async cancellation or a surviving blocking worker could escape Factory drain without a durable terminal fact.

defects.root_cause: No explicit run/session-scoped in-flight coordinator and no cancellation-resistant terminal ownership existed.
defects.remaining_risk: Concrete HTTP/streaming/SDK/CLI provider transports still require mandatory gate wiring and per-attempt drain coverage.

defects.symptom: Exactly-64-thread FactStream bootstrap intermittently reads an empty authority anchor and fails with lock_anchor_invalid.
defects.evidence: Main-agent combined acceptance: 233 passed in 79.50s, including the 49-test lock suite and deterministic bootstrap interleaving coverage; implementation-agent stress evidence additionally completed 320 concurrent bootstrap calls without failure. Ruff check/format, mypy, compileall, and git diff --check passed.
defects.root_cause: Initial provision publishes anchor.lock with O_CREAT|O_EXCL before acquiring its flock and writing the binding, allowing a competing opener to lock and read the empty inode first.
defects.remaining_risk: Cross-process authority behavior remains fail-closed by the existing malformed-anchor and inode proofs; future storage-authority changes must preserve the provision-lock ordering.

defects.symptom: Async streaming helpers perform raw aiohttp session.post attempts and reconnects without a per-physical-attempt frozen snapshot, start/terminal lifecycle pair, or cancellation-resistant drain ownership.
defects.evidence: Main-agent focused acceptance: 64 passed in 2.90s; combined Phase-A acceptance: 264 passed in 79.58s; Ruff check/format, mypy on all five slice files, compileall, and git diff --check passed. Independent quality review returned PASS after verifying real session.post interception, failed/failed/completed retry terminals, frozen mutation equivalence, response/session cleanup, aclose, BaseException, and second-cancellation behavior.
defects.root_cause: The first async dispatch slice modeled single awaited results and blocking workers, but not an async response context whose physical attempt remains open through iteration, consumer aclose, and response cleanup.
defects.remaining_risk: The helper default remains legacy_ungoverned until explicit provider cutover and registry preflight; direct provider-specific aiohttp/httpx, SDK, and CLI transports remain separate Phase-A slices.

defects.symptom: The governed synchronous HTTP gate records a completed terminal as soon as requests.post returns, before invoke_with_retry classifies HTTP 429, 4xx, or 5xx as a failed physical attempt.
defects.evidence: Main-agent focused acceptance: 67 passed in 3.13s; combined Phase-A acceptance: 267 passed in 80.18s; Ruff check/format, mypy on all three slice files, compileall, and git diff --check passed. Independent quality review returned PASS after proving one POST per attempt, identical response identity, 429/400 failed-then-completed, 401/500 failed, 200 completed, and preserved Retry-After/self-heal/breaker/legacy behavior.
defects.root_cause: The synchronous physical send callback returns raw non-OK HTTP responses to the gate, making transport return synonymous with attempt success even though HTTP response validation and retry decisions happen afterward.
defects.remaining_risk: HTTP status lifecycle semantics are closed; 200 responses whose JSON/provider extraction fails and enters physical retry remain a separate FPR-A-006 blocker.

defects.symptom: A governed synchronous HTTP 200 response is terminalized as completed before response.json or provider extraction runs, even when those operations raise and the helper treats the same physical attempt as failed or retryable.

defects.root_cause: The governed sync attempt boundary now includes HTTP status classification but still ends before response body JSON decoding and provider-specific response extraction that can drive retry/error control flow.
defects.remaining_risk: This closes only the governed synchronous helper. Direct provider transports and the end-to-end PM/Chief Engineer/Director/QA per-attempt qualification gate remain open Phase-A/Phase-B work. Exceptions outside the legacy retry taxonomy still escape after the gate durably records failed.

defects.symptom: The shared native async non-stream provider helper performs every httpx POST and all response parsing outside AsyncPhysicalProviderDispatchPort, so physical attempts used by async Gemini and Ollama cannot produce authoritative snapshots or lifecycle facts.
defects.evidence: Main-agent acceptance: 79 focused tests passed in 7.39s and 283 combined tests passed in 83.12s; Ruff, format, mypy, compileall, and scoped diff checks passed. defects.root_cause: Only the synchronous requests helper and aiohttp stream helpers were adapted to the generic physical-dispatch contract; the shared httpx non-stream retry helper retained its legacy direct-send boundary.
defects.remaining_risk: The generic helper seam is closed, but async Gemini/Ollama call-site cutover, provider-specific wire semantic projection, direct async streams, SDK/CLI transports, and per-role Factory qualification remain separate Phase-A/Phase-B work. defects.evidence: Main-agent acceptance: 75 focused tests passed in 1.80s and 262 Phase-A combined tests passed in 81.01s; Ruff, format, mypy on all eight slice files, compileall, and scoped diff checks passed. Putting the port into invoke_cfg would contaminate provider configuration, ContextOS option projection, and snapshot-safety enforcement.

Streaming, direct provider/SDK/CLI cutover, and Factory completion qualification remain open fail-closed Phase-A/Phase-B work.

Authoritative Factory cutoff ledger/ACK, canonical source reconstruction and absence proof, provider-visible anchor injection, physical qualification, streaming/direct-provider cutover, and Factory completion gating remain exclusively in A009B and later buckets.

defects.symptom: A legacy workspace-admission test expects a failed settled stage to release the active lease immediately, while the current Factory service retains failed/cancelled stage claims for explicit settlement and re-entry reconciliation.
defects.evidence: The reconciled contract is now tested end to end: failed stage settlement retains the ACTIVE lease and exact stage/attempt/nonce claim; canonical TaskRuntime settlement plus explicit reconcile clears that claim while preserving ACTIVE; only terminal settlement under a closed Run Ledger barrier releases the workspace with release evidence. Stale execution identity returns lease_version_mismatch before recovery mutation. Fresh main-agent affected-suite acceptance passed 475 tests and the complete Factory Pipeline suite passed 1056 tests; independent final review returned CLEAR.
defects.root_cause: The stage-claim lifecycle contract changed from wrapper-return release to explicit post-failure settlement/re-entry, but the broad admission contract and tests have not been fully reconciled.
defects.remaining_risk: Closed. Failed/cancelled claims remain fail-closed and require explicit reconciliation; no wrapper-return release or weakened fencing was restored.

defects.symptom: The first Factory role-evidence cutoff implementation passes fake-ledger tests but cannot issue Director or QA cutoffs through the real FactStream because one locator-only cutoff event exceeds the platform's 4KiB fact-record limit.
defects.evidence: The original probes reproduced Director failure at 4280 bytes and QA failure at 5237 bytes. The replacement protocol now uses 1024-byte raw fragments (bounded to 64KiB/64 fragments) plus one small authoritative commit. Fresh real PM, chief_engineer, director, and QA tests fsync every physical record below 4096 bytes and replay through a new port without recapturing source heads. Complete-partial recovery, commit ACK-loss, incomplete partials, full-head/workspace/stream/storage drift, lease expiry, strict DTO/scalar/container boundaries, and StageResult leak cases are covered. Main verification passed 216 related tests; independent final reviews returned PASS and APPROVED.
defects.root_cause: A009B1 serialized the complete source-cut body into one issued event instead of using a bounded chunk-plus-commit protocol whose authoritative ACK points only to the final commit fact.
defects.remaining_risk: Closed for correctness. A mid-fragment failure intentionally leaves that freeze fail-closed and incomplete; this is a documented liveness tradeoff, not authority. A009B2 must supply canonical source reconstruction before any live provider binding is allowed.

defects.symptom: Cancellation of an awaited authoritative Factory append returns to the caller before the surviving blocking worker reaches a terminal durable outcome.
defects.evidence: TDD first proved CancelledError propagated while the worker was still active. The repaired API now shields terminal settlement, preserves a terminal worker failure as the cancellation cause, survives repeated cancellation, and releases the stream lock before returning. Main-agent acceptance passed the 35-test event-chain suite; independent code-quality review returned APPROVED.
defects.root_cause: append_authoritative_event did not own a cancellation-resistant worker task or shield settlement before re-raising cancellation, allowing a durable-but-unacknowledged admission window.
defects.remaining_risk: Closed for Factory event append: cancellation returns only after terminal worker settlement. A cancelled successful admission may leave one strict genesis without run.json; that admission-only half-run is intentionally quarantined, unpublished and absent from list projections.

defects.symptom: First enrollment of a new Factory event stream can wait without bound behind another stream's shared authority-anchor lease.
defects.evidence: TDD proved missing maintenance timeouts, deadline reset, different-stream enrollment delay and a fresh-anchor deadline omission before each repair. Main-agent acceptance passed 57 locked-file, 35 event-chain and 93 maintenance/FactStream/retention tests. Fresh/existing provision, enrollment and acquire now consume finite single deadlines; Factory uses one total five-second budget. Dedicated lock review returned PASS.
defects.root_cause: KernelOne provision/enrollment maintenance and LockedRegularFileSet acquisition do not share one finite monotonic deadline; acquire also recomputes its budget between the anchor and stream locks.
defects.remaining_risk: Closed for bounded fail-closed admission. A fresh-anchor timeout can leave isolated partial lock-authority scaffolding, but reconciliation semantics reject it and it cannot create Factory events, run snapshots, list entries or publish facts; automatic maintenance recovery is a separate non-authoritative liveness enhancement.

Focused producer, provenance and stage-transaction suites are included in the 268-test main-agent acceptance; independent final reviews returned CLEAR.

defects.remaining_risk: Closed for A009B2a2. A009B2b must resolve the latest successful bound PM contract and its derived target-files view at the captured source cut.

Factory supplies the canonical PM task through the producer-consumed slot, and persisted-blueprint regressions are included in the 47-test provenance suite. Independent final reviews returned CLEAR.

defects.remaining_risk: Closed for A009B2a2. A009B2b must resolve the exact current review manifest and one-to-one ordered immutable blueprint vector through this public query.

defects.symptom: A descriptor-stable source read can still be replaced atomically before the authoritative stage event append.
defects.evidence: Factory now copies strict descriptor-stable PM/CE bytes into content-addressed immutable snapshots under guarded KernelOne file authority, re-reads and hashes the snapshot, and binds source plus snapshot hashes in the authoritative stage intent before commit. Replacement, symlink, hard-link, identity-drift and collision regressions passed; independent artifact and transaction reviews returned CLEAR.
defects.root_cause: No Factory-owned content-addressed immutable snapshot currently bridges the source-read and authoritative-event boundaries.
defects.remaining_risk: Closed for A009B2a2. A009B2b must independently re-read these exact immutable refs and compare both byte and canonical hashes before issuing source anchors.

defects.symptom: Stage completion currently saves mutable run.json before appending and publishing the authoritative event, then checkpoints, while mutating caller objects in place.
defects.evidence: The stage path now appends a detached authoritative intent first, persists the mutable run, exact immutable checkpoint and strict hashes, appends a durable commit marker, then publishes. A shared permit linearizes cancellation against append/fsync/post-read; unmatched intents and pre-ACK cancellation quarantine. Router automatic mutations use the Service per-run lock. Main-agent acceptance passed 52 persistence, 35 event-chain and 26 Store tests plus 155 role-evidence tests; independent final reviews returned CLEAR.
defects.root_cause: The stage commit path was designed as a UI lifecycle projection rather than an event-authoritative detached transaction with durable quarantine semantics.
defects.remaining_risk: Closed for A009B2a2. Publish remains a replayable non-authoritative fanout after the durable transaction; A009B2b must require event/current-state/snapshot agreement before creating any policy cut.

defects.symptom: The checkpoint-ref DTO accepted a valid-shaped immutable checkpoint filename whose status token was not a real Factory run lifecycle status.
defects.evidence: The prior parser accepted banana_2026-07-19T01_02_03Z.json. It now reuses the unique internal FactoryRunStatus enum, rejects banana with checkpoint_ref_invalid, and dynamically tests all seven actual lifecycle values. Main-agent persistence acceptance passed 52 tests; independent specification and quality reviews returned CLEAR.
defects.root_cause: The frozen filename grammar constrained status only as a generic lowercase identity instead of the authoritative FactoryRunStatus enum.
defects.remaining_risk: Closed. Service reconstruction still independently requires the checkpoint ref to equal the exact Store projection of checkpoint status plus updated_at.

defects.symptom: A canonical execution.control_plane fact can be appended successfully and then duplicated when rebuildable Run Ledger persistence or the returned ACK fails and the same logical event is retried.
defects.evidence: The canonical public append now derives one stable Fact idempotency key and projection append identity, reserves capacity before Fact mutation, holds the projection flock across Fact append and projection commit, and publishes only after unlock. Retry reuses the original Fact receipt and exact recorded_at. Binary scanning validates canonical complete rows while preserving an incomplete UTF-8 tail; write/flush/fsync failures durably roll back or enter strict recovery. Recovery pages at most 4096 same-run Facts in at most five 1000-record pages, validates exact Fact identity, sequence, candidate envelope and ordered projection prefix, requires the only unprojected authority to be the current final Fact, and then truncates/fsyncs plus appends/fsyncs. Partial ASCII and multibyte writes, full-write ACK loss, rollback failure, orphan/mismatched/ambiguous/disguised/duplicate/reordered Facts, pagination stagnation/cycle/limits, capacity boundaries and concurrent replay are covered. Fresh main-agent final acceptance passed 401 RunLedger/FactStream tests, 394 TaskRuntime tests and 3 Factory legacy tests; all scoped static gates passed; independent specification review returned CLEAR and code-quality review returned APPROVED. FPR=N/A.
defects.root_cause: The authoritative FactStream append and rebuildable projection were ordered correctly but never shared one stable logical replay identity, and projection persistence has no lock-owned idempotent append contract.
defects.remaining_risk: Closed for stable replay and crash recovery. A009B2b-1 remains responsible for the separate seven-source resolver and absence-proof semantics; this bucket does not enable live role binding or any physical provider call.
